This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle.
